question: The Alipore Bomb Case of 1908 is associated with which Indian revolutionary?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aurobindo Ghosh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Alipore Bomb Case of 1908 was one of the most prominent trials during the Indian independence movement, involving revolutionaries accused of conspiring to overthrow British rule.
 
• Aurobindo Ghosh, a key figure in the Indian freedom struggle, was arrested and tried for his alleged role in the conspiracy.
 
• The case centered around the bomb that was intended to target a British official but instead killed two innocent women in Muzaffarpur.
 
• Aurobindo Ghosh was eventually acquitted due to lack of evidence, but the case marked a turning point in his life as he shifted from active politics to spiritual pursuits.
 
• His defense lawyer, Chittaranjan Das, famously described Aurobindo as "the poet of patriotism" and "the prophet of nationalism."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aurobindo Ghosh:** Known for his revolutionary activities and later as a spiritual leader, he founded the Aurobindo Ashram in Pondicherry.
 
• **The Anushilan Samiti:** A secret revolutionary organization involved in the Alipore Bomb Case, aimed at overthrowing British rule through armed struggle.
 
• **Chittaranjan Das:** A prominent lawyer and nationalist leader who defended Aurobindo Ghosh during the trial, highlighting his intellectual and spiritual contributions.
 
• **Impact of the Case:** The Alipore Bomb Case influenced the trajectory of the Indian freedom movement, inspiring many revolutionaries and leading to stricter British surveillance.
 
• **Shift to Spirituality:** After his acquittal, Aurobindo Ghosh moved away from revolutionary politics and focused on spiritual philosophy and integral yoga.
